0022600086.text: Washington hosts Milwaukee in the season opener for both teams, as neither has played a 2026-27 game yet. The Wizards will be without Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), and AJ Dybantsa is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while the Bucks have Jericho Sims (undisclosed) and Nate Ament (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The Wizards won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 109-99 win in Washington on January 29, 2026, their most recent meeting.
